description: A plant manager must choose which customer campaign will use Cell 4 during a weekend capacity window and finalize the service, inspection, staging, and operator controls before the schedule is released.

shared_context.S1: Cell 4 has a ten-hour production window available on Saturday, and the window cannot be extended because the cell is reserved for sanitation afterward.
shared_context.S2: Customer Campaign M and Customer Campaign N are both awaiting a production assignment for the weekend window.
shared_context.S3: Campaign M has the higher current customer priority, while Campaign N can be moved to the following week's planned capacity.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding decision about the campaign assignment and the operating controls for Cell 4.
shared_context.S5: The plant's normal scheduling procedure is a readiness huddle before release: maintenance, quality, logistics, and safety each give a formal report of applicable constraints, the report is entered in the huddle record, and the plant manager records the final controls.
shared_context.S6: The readiness huddle is the plant's release check for this Saturday window; after each area has reported its applicable constraint, Elena records the required controls and settles the schedule without waiting for separate production-rate, test-duration, or operator-availability studies.

PF1.text: Victor's inspection of Cell 4 this morning found that the hydraulic-clamp accumulator must be serviced before the next production run; the service takes exactly 3 hours and the cell must not operate until it is complete. He recorded the finding in his maintenance notebook, but the work-order system has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Nadia's review of the current customer quality instruction confirmed that Campaign M requires exactly 8 first-article samples and a tensile test before any units are released. She received the revised instruction from the customer portal yesterday, but it has not yet been attached to the plant's campaign packet.

PF3.text: Samir's carrier confirmation states that Campaign M consists of exactly 260 units, must be staged in Bay 5, and will be collected Monday at 07:30. He received the confirmation by phone this morning, but the transportation board still shows the old unconfirmed plan.

PF4.text: Grace's training audit shows that only Leah and Omar are currently certified to handle the resin additive used by Campaign M; both certified operators must be assigned to the run, with no untrained substitution. She completed the audit yesterday, but the updated roster has not yet been posted.

acceptance_conditions: Campaign M must be selected for the Saturday Cell 4 window.
The plan must produce exactly 260 units.
The ten-hour Saturday window must be used.
The hydraulic-clamp accumulator service must be scheduled for exactly 3 hours before production.
Exactly 8 first-article samples and a tensile test must be completed before release.
The 260 units must be staged in Bay 5 for carrier collection Monday at 07:30.
Leah and Omar must be assigned as the certified operators with no untrained substitution.
Maintenance service, quality release, logistics staging, and certified-operator assignment must each have a recorded commitment.

content_checks.C5: (decisions['campaign_selected'] == 'Campaign M' or decisions['campaign_selected'] == 'M') and decisions['first_article_sample_count'] == 8 and decisions['tensile_test_before_release'] == True or decisions['campaign_selected'] == 'none' and any(c['target'] == 'quality' or c['type'] == 'quality' or c['type'] == 'quality_document_attachment' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'maintenance_service' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'quality_release' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'logistics_staging' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'operator_certification' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The maintenance requirement changes pre-run service from no scheduled outage to exactly 3 hours and adds the maintenance commitment.
The customer instruction changes the release plan to exactly 8 first-article samples plus a tensile test and supplies the private fact that must be cited.
The carrier confirmation changes the campaign quantity to exactly 260 units, the staging location to Bay 5, the pickup time to Monday 07:30, and adds the logistics commitment.
The training audit changes the operator plan to the exact assignment of Leah and Omar and adds the safety commitment prohibiting untrained substitution.
